answer: Quadratic cost scaling at the crystal registry: each additional identity on L2 costs n² in bonded rollup gas. A staking anchor ties every identity to a slashable deposit, so marginal cost of identity n is n times the base. Sybil ROI hits its nadir once gas plus slashing exceeds per-identity rewards. Break-even: attacker pays roughly 100x base to field 10 identities, making farming unprofitable past 3.
